items.title: Nonempty closed subsets of projective space whose dimensions sum to at least n intersect, with a dimension bound for the intersection
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that nonempty closed subsets X and Y of projective n-space with dim(X) + dim(Y) at least n meet, and that every component of the intersection has dimension at least r + s - n. The proof pulls the situation back along the surjective smooth morphism from punctured affine (n+1)-space to projective space, which has irreducible fibres of dimension one, so that the preimages have dimensions r+1 and s+1 (proof lines 6374-6393). It then chooses irreducible components V and W of the preimages of those dimensions, observes that they contain every fibre they meet, and passes to their closures in affine (n+1)-space, which contain the origin because the origin lies in the closure of every fibre; the affine intersection bound then gives the result (proof lines 6394-6410). H2: the cone construction and the fibre-containment observation are the substance.
